items.name: MC-NES
items.author: MiSTer Control
items.summary: MiSTer Control's own build of the NES core, installed next to the stock one. It reports the game's memory, registers and controller state to this app every frame: live values on the game sheet and the Home screen. Same games, cheats, saves and settings as the stock NES core.

items.name: MC-Gameboy

It reports the game's memory, registers and controller state to this app every frame: live values on the game sheet and the Home screen, save-state-safe. Same games, cheats, saves and settings as the stock Gameboy core.

items.name: RetroAchievements (MiSTer main)
items.author: odelot
items.summary: A build of MiSTer main that unlocks RetroAchievements while you play, with popups on the TV and an achievement list on F6. It replaces the stock main binary until you remove it (your copy comes back then). update_all and the downloader put the stock main back on their next run; install again after. Enter your RetroAchievements login on the Settings page after the install. Needs the RetroAchievements build of each core you want achievements on (this list).

items.name: RA-NES
items.author: odelot
items.summary: The NES / FDS core with RetroAchievements support (validated hardcore), installed as RA-NES next to the stock core. With the RetroAchievements main installed, Play uses this build for the system when Settings > RetroAchievements says so.
